why: 0.2.0 phase 7. Start-up from the self-test's start-up line (process start to main window, private memory). Measured: AI off 0.74-0.76 s / 95-110 MB (warm, second run); AI on 0.75-2.1 s / 98-111 MB (cold, the first run after a build). The limits leave room for machine noise; a real regression (a module loaded at start-up, a blocking call) costs more than the headroom. Sizes: preview.4 + 5 %. 0.6.13 (ADR-092): the self-contained .NET 10 runtime adds 3.5 MB to the exe (77.2 → 80.5 MB), so both size limits are now the 0.6.13 sizes + 5 %. 0.6.14 (DarkCipher0x: "raise the AI-on budget to cover cold starts"): the build's AI-on run is the first, cold start after a build, and measured 2.3-3.6 s across 20 builds from 0.5.0 to 0.6.14 (worst 3,576 ms, on .NET 8 as well as .NET 10; warm starts 0.9-1.3 s), so 2.6 s failed builds on noise. AI on is now 4.0 s: the worst cold start + 10 %.
